limitations: All operating thresholds, the calibrator, and the conformal level are fit on calibration partitions only; no final-test label sets a threshold.
Cross-dataset LOCO holds an entire dataset out of training and calibration; pooled seen-cohort cells are never labeled external.
Split-conformal coverage and calibration are population-conditional and not guaranteed after distribution shift.
The sealed pooled test partition and external targets are evaluated once with the frozen production scorer under --finalize.
RAID clean is a seen cohort (in pooled training); only RAID attack cells are external robustness tests.
The dataset-origin probe reports shortcut risk as a limitation, not as proof all shifts are detectable.
Dataset-origin probe predicts cohort at 0.81 (chance 0.33); transport gaps may reflect shortcut features.
